testcase.name: hidden page keeps an independent workspace badge and a bounded timer
all-workspaces scope omits the workspace filter and stream parameter
continuous invalidation is batched with a one-second maximum wait
refreshes arriving during a slow request coalesce without overlapping work
refresh deadline includes request elapsed time and wake rechecks immediately
workspace transition aborts old work and ignores its late unauthorized response
filter changes cancel an old page without adopting its late content
pagination appends only one stable page and respects an exhausted cursor
pagination409 discards every previous page and obtains a fresh snapshot
inconsistent pagination never merges changed revisions or duplicate episodes
network failures retain last authorized page and badge without false zeros
initial network failure remains unknown and a timed-out request cannot block retries
seen and snooze send captured CAS once, with no optimistic canonical change
lost mutation response reconciles with reads and never resubmits the preference
mutation409 refreshes CAS and a stale click is never sent
closed SSE reauthorizes through HTTP and clears on401 without reconnecting
stream loss with available API retains data and reconnects with current cursor
source_unavailable immediately marks a pending preference snapshot stale without replay
transport_error immediately marks a pending preference snapshot stale without replay
reset and retention gaps request snapshots without exposing historical notifications
authorization loss,403 and featureoff clear authorized data and timers
clear, disable and unmount ignore late successful requests and resolve pending actions
repeated conflict is bounded and malformed stream controls cannot authorize or clear data
